import json
def transform3(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    out=[]
    for r in g:
        nr=list(r)
        if r[0]==marker:
            # first run length
            run=0
            while run<len(r) and r[run]==marker: run+=1
            if run>=2:
                last=max(i for i,x in enumerate(r) if x==marker)
                for i in range(last+1,len(r)):
                    if nr[i]==bg: nr[i]=1
        out.append(nr)
    return out
